scope: 10 English posts: 8 SaaS brand posts from Buffer, plus 2 adjacent business/book promotions by Kit founder Nathan Barry. Supplemental brand reply examples are recorded separately.
selection: Convenience sample of public profile grid/recent feed posts, not a randomized sample. Within-account pairs and two cross-platform matched campaigns reduce some confounding but do not establish causation.
access: Fresh headless Chromium contexts without login, personal browser, profile, cookies, or private API access. Public visible content only.
missing_values: null means unavailable or an unlabeled/blank displayed count; it never means zero.
measurement_rules: Prefer rendered UI over page metadata; preserve discrepancies. Rounded follower displays are not exact denominators. Views are not reach or conversions. Related threads are not replies. A brand follow-up is not an independent audience reply.

reply_examples.parent_paraphrase: Reader reports a 95-week Buffer posting streak.
reply_examples.reply_paraphrase: References the reader's specific posting streak, celebrates it briefly, uses emojis, and signs with a team member's name.
reply_examples.provisional_policy: For praise or milestones, acknowledge the specific detail briefly. Warmth, emoji use, and signed replies are editable brand settings. Do not invent a staff identity.
reply_examples.observed_child_response: Reader acknowledges or thanks the named team member.
